label: Estate dependency confrontation - opening
description: Hannah’s room: a closed, luxurious confrontation where care becomes constraint.
text: The room is quiet, luxurious, and carefully controlled, with Hannah already occupying the emotional center of it. The controlling mother has privacy, resources, and absolute confidence in the order of her own house, while the adult child has been drawn into a conversation that feels intimate, suffocating, and impossible to escape cleanly. Every reassurance carries pressure, and every comfort offered comes with the expectation of surrender.
